title: Chitosan-derived carbon supported ruthenium catalyst for efficient hydrogenation of levulinic acid to γ-valerolactone
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5921-5930
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00988J, Paper
Lavanya Korampattu, Paresh L. Dhepe
This study explores the effect of N-doping in a chitosan derived N-doped carbon supported ruthenium catalyst for the hydrogenation of levulinic acid.
